subject: DPA: subprocessor inventory, SCC alignment & transfer execution playbook
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie.green@clearwell.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rinehart <alex.rinehart@clearwell.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial DPA redlines + subprocessor inventory

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I'm attaching our initial DPA redlines and the Q3 subprocessor inventory for ClearWell. A few things we want to resolve quickly so procurement can sign off:

- Confirmation of which SCC clause set Redwood intends to adopt (module or updated EU Commission addendum).
- Whether Redwood will accept the proposed processor role delegations in Exhibit A or if you need a handover matrix.
- A pragmatic approach for US->EU transfer carveouts: we prefer a transfer-impact addendum with an operational runbook rather than bespoke clause language on each contract.

Can you confirm who on your legal side will own the redline and who will own the operational runbook so we can align internal approvers?

Attachments: ClearWell_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx (DOCX), Subprocessor_Inventory_Q3.csv (CSV)

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Green
Head of Procurement
ClearWell Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@clearwell.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines + subprocessor inventory

Thanks Sophie — got the attachments and inventory.

Proposed split of responsibilities:
- Legal redline owner: Laura Bennett (cc'd) will take the DPA document and produce a clean set of counter-redlines.
- Operational runbook & transfer impact playbook: Ben Carter will coordinate our infra team and produce the step-by-step runbook that maps to the carveouts you suggested.

Immediate asks for us to triage the redlines quickly:
1) Sophie: can you call out the top 6 "blocking" clauses (by clause header) so Laura can prioritize?
2) Alex: if any subprocessor entries in the CSV are subject to cross-border escrow or separate SOC evidence, flag them in the sheet (column Z).

We will aim for a first-pass counter-redline by Wed EOD PT and a draft execution playbook by Thu EOD PT. If that timing is tight for you, let me know.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Execution_Playbook_v1.pdf - initial outline)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sophie Green <sophie.green@clearwell.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + prioritization request

Hi all — I reviewed ClearWell_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx and captured high-priority items. Quick summary below (full comments in the attached counter-redline):

Top 6 blocking items (Laura priority list):
- Clause 4.2 (Processor Subprocessors): we need clarity on "open-ended delegation" language; propose Exhibit A with a delegation roster and 30-day notice for additions.
- Clause 6.1 (Cross-border Transfers): prefer standard EU Commission SCCs + transfer impact addendum; cannot accept perpetual bespoke carveouts without operational mitigations.
- Clause 8.5 (Audit Rights): narrow to third-party attestation (SOC2 type II) and pre-defined operational windows; suggest use of shared evidence folder rather than on-site audits.
- Clause 10.3 (Data Retention & Deletion): align on retention schedules by data class — will propose a schedule appendix.
- Clause 12 (Security Standards): map to our existing control set (ISO27001 + specific encryption requirements) and include exception process.
- Clause 14 (Liability Cap carveouts for controlled exfiltration): redline to limit to direct damages with a carveout cap for security incidents only.

Attached: Laura_Counter_DPA_v1.docx (DOCX with tracked changes)

Note to Sophie: we will keep SCC selection flexible but recommend the modernized EU SCCs (2024 text) and add the transfer impact addendum you requested — operational mitigations should live in the Playbook so legal text can remain standard.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Laura_Counter_DPA_v1.docx)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@clearwell.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 14:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + prioritization request

Sophie — quick commercial timeline from our side to help procurement:
- Wed 10/11: Redwood legal issues counter-redline (Laura) and we deliver operational playbook draft (Ben).
- Thu 10/12: ClearWell to review redline + playbook; if minor, procurement can sign and we proceed to Order Form finalization.
- Mon 10/16: Target customer signature (we'll allow a short review window).

Couple of notes:
- For any subprocessor that is EU-hosted vs US-hosted, the playbook will differentiate controls. Please see column "Location" in your CSV; Alex, can you confirm any entries listed as "US (hosting) - critical"?
- Pricing/credits for any additional audit/evidence work: we can offer one free evidence package (SOC2 report + cross-border evidence bundle) per 12-month period; additional requests would be handled as a Professional Services engagement. We'll document this in the Order Form.

Ben Carter
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@clearwell.com>, Alex Rinehart <alex.rinehart@clearwell.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + prioritization request

All — quick execution checklist and next steps:

1) Legal: Laura to upload counter-redline into the shared Drive and add clause-by-clause rationale. (Due: Wed 10/11 11:59 PT) (Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearwell-dpa)
2) Ops: Ben to produce Transfer Impact Playbook (sections: subprocessor mapping, cross-border routes, evidence package procedures, escalation flow). (Due: Thu 10/12 EOD PT)
3) Customer action: Sophie/Alex to flag any CSV rows that require an "evidence escrow" or special SOC scope and call out the 6 blocking clauses in a short email. (Due: Thu 10/12 noon PT)
4) Commercial: Ben to add 1x complimentary evidence package clause to Order Form and prepare the final Order Form redline. (Due: Fri 10/13)

If timelines hold we can close the DPA + Order Form in a single signature event next week. If anything slips on your side, call out the blockers and we'll raise an escalation lane to our Privacy Committee.

Thanks — appreciate the quick collaboration.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Execution_Playbook_v1.pdf - outline)
